title: Jump Game 2
problemStatement: Solve “Jump Game 2” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Medium/Hard).
intuition: "Jump Game 2" may admit a greedy choice. Sort by the right key, then take the next safe candidate. Prove exchange argument or cite a known theorem.

approaches.title: Greedy after sorting
approaches.idea: Sort, then scan once taking locally optimal safe moves.
approaches.time: Usually O(n log n) from sort
approaches.whyWorks: Exchange: any optimal solution can be transformed into the greedy one without loss.

complexity.time: Usually O(n log n) from sort

commonMistakes: Greedy without proof → WA on counterexamples
Using DP when greedy suffices (or the reverse)

followUps: Counterexample if sorted by start instead?
